NBA and EuroLeague Pathway Camp 2026

Three days with Tremaine Dalton and Deng Awak on what NBA, EuroLeague and college coaches look for, ages 13 to 17

  • Measured like the NBA Draft Combine
  • Your game on film, packaged to keep

  • The shooting machine
  • Hot lunch Monday and Tuesday

Sign up for the December camp

Your coaches: Tremaine Dalton and Deng

Leads the camp, all three days

Tremaine Dalton

Founder of The Process Basketball

  • Camp director for the NBA Basketball Schools in Europe
  • Technical director of the NBA Basketball School Portugal since 2024
  • Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame contributor nominee for the class of 2026
  • Trains NBA and EuroLeague players and French national team players
  • Played pro in France, Israel and Australia

Tremaine leads the camp Monday to Wednesday. He runs sessions with you, watches your games and leads our Coaches Clinic on Monday and Tuesday. Deng Awak, Talata's Head Coach, is on court all three days supporting him and running the camp around you. Bring your questions.

Mathias Lessort trained with Tremaine in Paris before winning the EuroLeague with Panathinaikos in 2024. Tremaine has also worked with NBA champion Serge Ibaka, Phoenix Suns wing Adonis Arms and Boston Celtics first round pick James Young.

He grew up in Grand Rapids, Michigan, and Cleveland Cavaliers great Campy Russell is his uncle. Les Deux, the Copenhagen brand, featured him in its Creator Stories and rebuilt a public court in New York with him in 2023.

Deng Awak

Founder of Talata Basketball

  • Captained Mount Royal University in Calgary, U SPORTS Canada West
  • Pro in Canada, Lithuania and Denmark, including BK Amager in the Basketligaen
  • Has coached in four countries: Canada, Lithuania, Indonesia and Denmark
  • Ran the Talata Canada Camp in Lethbridge, Alberta, in July 2026

Deng's full profile

What you do

You get measured, you get filmed, and you get a written evaluation on the last day. Height, wingspan, standing reach, vertical and lane agility are the tests NBA scouts run at the Draft Combine.

A day at camp

09:30 to 11:30
Testing and skills. Height, wingspan, standing reach, vertical, lane agility and timed shooting
11:30 to 12:30
Lunch, then film. Your own footage from the morning
12:30 to 14:00
Live play, filmed from a fixed camera
Wed 30 Dec
Game day. Warm up from 09:30, games from 10:30 to 14:00, filmed. Fruit and snacks, no lunch. Each player gets a written evaluation at the end

Once during the camp, an NBA or EuroLeague coach joins by live video call to tell you how they got there and what they look for. We name each guest once they confirm.

Game day and your film

Wednesday 30 December is game day. Games start at 10:30 and every game is filmed from a fixed camera. You can watch your own footage the same day.

After camp we package your game film together with your written evaluation and share it with you. It is yours to keep and to share with scouts, coaches and schools.

The pathway

The numbers from Monday, the film from game day and the written evaluation are what a prep school or college coach asks to see. This camp gives you all three in one place.

Talata players have gone on to Fort Erie and Orangeville Prep in Canada, Martins Ferry High School in Ohio and The Patrick School program in New Jersey. See where they went.

Questions parents ask

What do they bring?

Indoor shoes and a water bottle. Lunch on Monday and Tuesday, fruit and snacks all three days and the camp t-shirt come from us, and the shooting machine is in the hall all three days.

Drop off and pick up?

Start 09:30, pick up 14:00, all three days.

Who is it for?

Players aged 13 to 17 who are already in a club and want to know where they stand.

Who else is in the gym?

On Monday and Tuesday, coaches from other clubs join for our Coaches Clinic. They run stations and take the game teams with our coaches and Tremaine, and they are welcome back for Wednesday's games.

Sign up

50 places. We confirm by email and send the payment details.

Ages 13 to 17 on 28 December.
